posts.title: Using Claude Code in devcontainers
posts.description: I run Claude Code inside a development container , for the simple reason that the container is a sandbox. I can let Claude Code loose on a project and know that whatever it does, it does not escape the sandbox. Devcontainers are a good fit for this.
